lines.en: I waddle as I walk
I swing my two soft legs
I shuffle forward in small steps
My shadow leans badly
I loop my way toward you
I stick my head out first
I walk crooked as anything
My feet slap the ground
I hop closer and closer
I drag my feet, worn out
I come out of the grass
I sway in, one step at a time
I wiggle along a side path
I come across the petals

lines.zh: 我站着，忘了自己在做什么。
lines.en: I stand here, forgetting what I was doing.
I hold a breath in my mouth
Standing, I lean to one side
I blink my wide eyes
My body sways twice
I open my mouth and shut it
I turn in place
I space out for a while
I scratch my own head
I hum a tuneless note
I nod along to nothing
I let my tongue hang out
I stare down at my own feet
I stare at you sideways
You are bigger than I thought
I open my mouth a bit
Your shadow is on me

lines.zh: 我学你的样子，歪了下头。
lines.en: I tilt my head, copying yours.
I crane my neck at you
Do you want to come along
I lift one soft leg
My smile comes out strange
I spin once on the spot
I bob my head at you
I crane forward, head askew
I pull my mouth into a grin
I sway even more
Forty health, and a good chunk is gone.
I hold my own leg
This face of mine is stitched from memes.
I let out a dull grunt
I lurch to one side
I cannot quite stand
I can still sway my way over
Do not hit me again
I stand open-mouthed, speechless
Give me a taste
I wait with my mouth open
This looks edible
Do not pull it back
I bite and will not let go

lines.zh: 你手里那玩意儿……能吃不？
lines.en: That thing in your hand... can I eat it?

lines.zh: 鼻子告诉我，你藏着好东西。
lines.en: My nose says you're hiding something good.

lines.zh: 换我一口，我就少撞你一次。
lines.en: One bite for me, and I'll bump you one less time.
I land flat on my rear
Hitting me is like hitting dough
I get up and fall again
I steady myself on the wall
Knocked askew, I slowly turn back.
I grunt at you
Now I lean the other way

lines.zh: 让一让，我的脑袋比腿先到。
lines.en: Step aside — my head arrives before my legs.
I tip my head, uncomprehending
I do not really understand this
I only wander about
If you want to wander with me
I have no plans at all
I take it as a game
I spin once and come back
I am not good at this
Let me stuff it in and try
Why is this so hard
I take it and shake it
I hug it and walk two steps
It falls, I pick it up again
I have no idea what it is for
I spin in place holding it

lines.zh: 这归我了，谁捡到算谁的。
lines.en: This is mine now — finders keepers.
You are standing there still
I am coming to have a look
I could give this a try
I start walking your way
Let me move a leg first
Decided, it is you
I lean in and quicken my step
I am ready to bump you
You cannot dodge this at all
I am coming with my mouth open
My legs are weak, but I do not stop.
You go left, so do I
I chase with my head tilted
Soft legs, but I do not stop
I have already caught you
You turn, I circle
I have your coat hem
One more nudge and I bite
I trot after you, my steps all wrong.
I have not fallen behind
I wait to catch you square
I bite down
I butt your side
I kick with a soft leg
I grab hold and cling
That one went wide
I swing my body into you
I flop onto you

lines.zh: 别跑，让我用脸撞你一下！
lines.en: Don't run — let me hit you with my face!
A head pops out of the grass
I come out from behind a bank
I lean over first
You hear a strange call
I walk out over the grass
I am not standing quite straight
I appear, swaying
A strange smell arrives
My head comes out first
I squeeze out from under the fence
The fire makes me hop about
I land in a heap

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，只会乱扑腾。
lines.en: I cannot swim; I only flail.
The blast rolls me over
An arrow sticks in my leg
Magic makes me go all soft
I am too hungry to walk
The thunder makes me jump
I tumble downward
